caption: The video captures an outdoor dusk scene where a low wooden table on dry grass is already burning, with a bright white-yellow flame core on its surface. Two upright cardboard cylinders sit in front of the table, a small box is partly visible beneath it, and a thin white cord lies on the ground to the left. A large smoke cloud rises around the flame, lit orange above and gray toward the right, while small sparks scatter outward and drift through the air. As the excerpt progresses, the flame core remains active but gradually contracts and shifts toward the left edge of the tabletop. The smoke continues to expand upward and outward, filling much of the upper frame and increasingly obscuring the weeds and tree line behind the setup. The table, cylinders, box, and cord keep their positions, with no clear camera movement apparent. The burning and smoke production continue throughout the visible portion without reaching a clear conclusion.
